This is the sum of the 12 monthly values of foresight_4h_revenue_total_usd_per_mw (battery_stack_monthly, derived). The sum is 3,430,556.56 USD/MW. Months are local (Central) months. questions.question: In June 2026, how much higher or lower was the load-weighted real-time price at ERCOT's hub average than at CAISO's SP15 hub, in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: ERCOT's hub average was higher. In June 2026 its load-weighted real-time price was 29.40 USD/MWh, against 13.69 USD/MWh at CAISO's SP15 hub (TH_SP15_GEN-APND). That makes ERCOT 15.71 USD/MWh higher, a difference computed by the compare tool. Both figures are for the complete month (720 of 720 hours) and come from cost_of_power_monthly. That table is derived by the ERW and is a wholesale-energy-only price. The load weighting uses EIA-930 demand. The month is the local month.
